dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I'm pretty nervous, to be honest. The battles here are tough, and I don't wanna let the team down...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Still... I can't just mope around, wishing I was as brave as everyone else. That helps no one.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: No, I won't run away. Not me. That's right, Trainee Forest Ranger Collei is ready for battle!
